newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI EASIER WITH NOKIA IN SLACK SUMMER SESSION.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI EASIER WITH NOKIA IN SLACK SUMMER SESSION.

text.p: Shares dawdled in slightly
negative territory on Thursday, failing to draw strength from a
fourth straight record finish for U.S. stocks overnight as
Nokia fell near its lower Wall Street level.
Nokia A traded down 2.50 markka at 361.00, slightly above
its lower Wednesday Wall Street closing price equalling about
359.30 markka.
The fall came after Nokia gained 11.50 markka yesterday with
help from a reaffirmed "buy" recommendation from U.S. investment
bank Merrill Lynch, the impact of which was now exausted,
brokers said.
Brokers said the day's slate of interim reports had held
little to spark trading interest.
Raisio fell 2.00 markka to 418.00 in calm three
million markka trade after reporting January-April profits up
in line with analysts' forecasts in a Reuters poll.
Hackman was unchanged in very thin trade at 173.00
markka after its four-month earnings swung back into profit from
a loss in the same period last year.
"Hackman was positive," one broker said, "they're back on
track." But another said that much of Hackman's profit had come
from disposals rather than continuing businesses.
